objective: Walk through a fresh local account and fix reproduced UI/customization failures
acceptance_criteria: Fresh account and business/store customization work in the browser
Unsaved edits are protected during feedback navigation and workspace switching
Preview skip links stay hidden when unfocused and remain keyboard-accessible
Duplicate content URLs give actionable errors without changing saved content
Product image editor accepts same-site paths and API rejects unsafe image URLs
Targeted regressions, affected tests, typecheck and rebuilt local app pass
